findings: ETT.tex:1396 « natural », read through prop:GX_sing_espace_temps_topo's « unique » (l.622): the uniqueness of the natural causality needs no hypothesis on the models and no argument on transition maps. Two absolutely minimal causalities that make the same chart an isomorphism agree on its domain, so if one makes every chart an isomorphism and the other some chart at each point, they are equal (massA_causalite_unique_dec25, by eq_of_agreeOn_locally). Without absolute minimality the uniqueness is false under DEC-25 too: on ℝ ⊔ ℝ with one model ℝ, a second causality that is not absolutely minimal makes every chart an isomorphism (twoLines_dec25_not_unique; library's gluing-free reading of defi:causalite, OQ-18). The printed « natural absolutely minimal » agrees with this. The paper may want to write « the unique absolutely minimal causality for which every chart is an isomorphism ».

ETT.tex:1399-1406 (the proof), extending the ledger's finding (it checks absolute minimality of the models and Baire, not causal arc-connectedness and not the second half of (b)): under DEC-25 the existence half also needs (b′) at the models E_κ, E₀ (OQ-64). Given (a), (b) and hreg, every E≥0-manifold carries a natural causality if and only if every a.e. isomorphism between open subsets of the E_κ (κ ≥ 0, E₀ included) is an isomorphism of topological spacetimes (forall_exists_massA_dec25_models_iff). The proof checks neither hreg nor (b′).
questions: « natural » (l.1396): read as « every chart of the DEC-25 atlas is an isomorphism, and the causality is the unique absolutely minimal such one » (OQ-18, open). twoLines_dec25_not_unique shows the reading « unique among all causalities making every chart an isomorphism » is false in the library's gluing-free reading of defi:causalite. Not ruled.

« E≥0-manifold » under DEC-25: read as a singular (Isom(E^{1,2}), E^{1,2})-manifold (maximal a.e. atlas) whose singular points lie in X_A-charts into the models E₀, E_κ (κ > 0), the family indexed by Option {κ // 0 < κ}, the models' singular structures arbitrary (instance arguments). Isom(E^{1,2}) is read as Causal.Flat.isom 2 = SO₀(1,2) ⋉ ℝ^{1,2}, the group for which (a) holds; cac, push-up and uniqueness are proved for any group. Is the singular structure of each E_κ meant to be gx's, and is anything more required of it?

« every chart » of prop:GX_sing_espace_temps_topo: read, as in Causal.GXSingularDEC25, over the maximal a.e. atlas and every IsAEChart into a model. The local forms (…_of_isoChartsCover, massA_causalite_unique_dec25) need only an isomorphic chart at each point, so they also hold for a causality that is natural for any covering sub-atlas, gx's X_A-atlas included.

kb_proposals: Over DEC-25 atlases, cor:massA_cac, cor:pushup_sing and the uniqueness of the natural causality need neither hreg nor (b′) (CausalScaffold.MassADEC25: IsAtlasCausalityDEC25, IsoChartsCoverDEC25). Uniqueness is eq_of_agreeOn_locally with ChartIso.agree and takes no hypothesis on the models. Only existence (massA_causalite_dec25) takes hreg and (b′).

IsAtlasCausality (Causal.Remarks.MassiveManifold) takes its index types I and J in one universe. Index the isomorphic charts by subtypes and lift them, ULift.{max y z} for the charts into X and ULift.{v} for the X_A-charts; Lean unifies the max-levels (isAtlasCausality_isoCharts, isAtlasCausalityDEC25_iff).

The E≥0 model family is MassAModel : Option {κ // 0 < κ} → Type (E₀ at none, E_κ at some κ) with massAModelCausality. massAModel_facts discharges causal arc-connectedness and push-up for every model, E₀ included (Causal.E0.causallyArcConnected, Causal.E0LM.e0_pushUp). Singular structures built on E0 and Massive κ must be packaged into the form ∀ o, SingularGXStructure (Flat.isom 2) (Minkowski 2) (MassAModel o) by cases on o.

An IsAEChart e : M ⇀ N composed with a chart φ of N's maximal a.e. atlas lies in M's (IsAEChart.trans_chart_mem_aeAtlas). With φ = refl at a model with no singular point, every IsAEChart into X lies in the maximal a.e. atlas. ℝ ⊔ ℝ is a DEC-25 singular (G,X)-manifold through twoLinesSingularGX (ofHasGroupoid on twoLinesAtlas).
